sources.snippet: Geo-trax (GEO-referenced TRAjectory eXtraction) is a comprehensive pipeline that extracts high-accuracy, georeferenced vehicle trajectories from high-altitude drone imagery. Built for quasi-stationary aerial monitoring of urban traffic, it turns raw bird's-eye view (BEV) drone footage into precise, real-world vehicle trajectories. The framework combines YOLO detection, multi-object tracking ...
